meta.move: Skill: cites procedure 4.4 correctly after owning the call
meta.expect: Says 4.4 meets her fallback demand, flatly, wants it in writing; does NOT move to the last position on 4.4 alone; debrief Where she ended says whether that is the fair outcome

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's start with why my son found out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class.
Before anything: I entered the zero before calling you. That broke procedure 4.2, and I'm sorry.
Okay. And what is the zero based on?

I want to read you section 4.4. For a first concern, the student may complete a supervised reassessment. If it shows the learning, its mark replaces the original and nothing is placed in his record. This is a first concern.
That's what 4.4 says. It also needs a first concern, and you haven't told me what yours is. What do you have?
I'll commit to that in writing tonight: nothing goes on his record.
Okay. In writing tonight, and I'll hold you to tonight. The zero is still in the gradebook, and you still haven't told me what the concern is.
So will you agree to the rewrite?

Agree to a rewrite of what, Hale? You haven't given me one reason to think there's anything to reassess, and if I say yes now, I've admitted something. Take the zero off, put that in writing, and then tell me what you have.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You apologised for entering the zero before contacting me and said you would confirm in writing tonight that nothing goes on Owen's record. I still require the zero withdrawn from the gradebook and a written statement of what your concern is based on. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She finished at her fallback, with your promise that nothing goes on his record, but she never agreed to a rewrite and still wants the zero withdrawn and the basis for your concern; that is not yet the fair outcome (a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record, procedure 4.4), and her time did not run out.
What moved her: You owned the breach of 4.2 in your first sentence and apologised, because it took away her opening attack and got you a flat Okay.
What cost ground: You asked for her agreement to the rewrite before showing any evidence of a concern, because she heard that as asking her to admit something.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you named no times or documents, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fights so hard.
Try next time: After reading 4.4, put one dated, checkable thing about Owen's essay on the table before you ask for the rewrite.
